goal: Implement an append-only write-ahead log with FNV-1a checksums and torn-tail recovery.

steps.description: Implement checksum (FNV-1a 32-bit), WalWriter::open (append mode, create if missing), and append with little-endian [checksum][len][payload] framing
invariants: checksum matches the FNV-1a reference values for '', 'a', 'foobar'
append assigns 1-based sequential sequence numbers, continuing across reopen

steps.description: Implement recover: scan records, verify checksums, stop at the first torn or corrupted tail, truncate it in place
invariants: all intact records are returned in write order
a torn (truncated) final record is discarded and the file is truncated so appends continue with the right sequence
a corrupted final record (checksum mismatch) is discarded
